parameters.name: DatabaseIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the databases that you want to add to the network domain.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The bastion host ID.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the bastion host ID.

parameters.name: NetworkDomainId
parameters.description:
The ID of the network domain to which you want to add databases.

> You can call the [ListNetworkDomains](~~2758827~~) operation to query the network domain ID.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host.
> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost move-databases-to-network-domain --instance-id bastionhost-cn-zpr3h2zo60l --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --network-domain-id 3 --database-ids 1,2 --region cn-hangzhou
